themes.theme: Policy Rationale, Objectives and Legal Context
themes.reason: Establishes why a national ban was chosen as the response to overfishing, linking it to MSY/CFP/MSFD obligations and Biodiversity 2020 commitments; without this rationale the choice of intervention has no justification.

Lays out the alternatives (voluntary v-notching, IFCA byelaws, seasonal ban, do-nothing) and explains why each was rejected in favour of a national SI ban, directly addressing why this intervention was selected over others.

themes.theme: Costs of the Policy to Business and Government
themes.reason: Provides the monetised cost estimates (lost revenue, familiarisation, enforcement) that are essential to the government's assessment of the proposal's net impact and trade-offs.

Supplies the modelling evidence on stock biomass and landings recovery that justifies accepting near-term costs for long-term conservation and fishery viability benefits, a core support for the chosen intervention.

Details the underlying data sources and simplifying assumptions used to derive the cost and benefit figures; it strengthens evidential transparency but is supporting detail rather than an independent pillar of the proposal argument.

themes.theme: Overall Net Benefit and Impact Summary
themes.reason: Summarises the net present value figures already derived from the costs and benefits themes; it restates rather than adds a distinct line of argument for the chosen intervention.
